title: Leave No Trace (LNT) for High Alpine Environments

principles.name: Plan Ahead & Prepare
principles.detail: Understand local climate windows, regulations, and pack emergency rations to avoid hazardous foraging or abandoning equipment.

principles.name: Travel & Camp on Durable Surfaces
principles.detail: Camp on established glacier snowfields, rock ledges, or bare gravel; never pitch tents on fragile alpine tundra or wildflower mats.

principles.name: Pack Out Everything You Pack In
principles.detail: Every candy wrapper, freeze-dried foil pouch, micro-trash, tape scrap, and human waste bag must be carried back to base camp.

principles.name: Respect Mountain Wildlife
principles.detail: Maintain distance from snow leopards, Himalayan ibex, markhor, and golden eagles. Store all rations in airtight bear/animal resistant containers.

principles.name: Climb High, Sleep Low
principles.detail: Trek or climb 500m-800m higher during daytime carries, then return to a lower camp elevation to sleep.

principles.name: The 500m Sleeping Rule
principles.detail: Above 3,000m (10,000ft), limit daily net gain in sleeping elevation to no more than 300m - 500m per 24-hour cycle.

principles.name: Rest Days Every 1,000m
principles.detail: Schedule a dedicated non-travel rest day for every 1,000m of net vertical altitude gain.

principles.name: Hydration is Oxygenation
principles.detail: Consume a minimum of 4 to 5 liters of electrolyte-fortified warm fluids daily to compensate for hyperventilation and extreme dry air.

principles.name: The Alpine Distress Signal
principles.detail: Emit 6 blasts on a whistle or 6 light flashes per minute at equal intervals, pause for 1 minute, then repeat. Response signal is 3 blasts/flashes per minute.

principles.name: Helicopter LZ Marking (Karakoram / Himalayas)
principles.detail: Form a human 'Y' (Yes - Need Pick Up) with arms raised overhead; lay a large high-vis orange tarp secured with heavy boulders into the wind direction.

principles.name: Satellite Two-Way Communicator SOS
principles.detail: Trigger SOS on Garmin inReach / ZOLEO; remain at exact GPS coordinates; transmit victim vitals, conscious status, and exact medical symptoms.
